mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP_MASTER E INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER D ON (E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND E.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = D.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (E.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = C.DOMAIN_ID)
E.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND E.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd} AND (E.HIDDEN_YN != 'Y' OR E.HIDDEN_YN IS NULL)
AND D.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE REPLACE(CONCAT('%', #{empNm}, '%'), ' ','')
ORDER BY DEPT_ORD, DEPT_NM, EMP_NM

SELECT E.EMP_NM , E.EMAIL , E.COMPANY_CD FROM EMP_MASTER E JOIN DEPT_MASTER D ON (E.DOMAIN_ID = D.DOMAIN_ID AND E.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD) JOIN CODE_DETAIL C ON (E.DOMAIN_ID = C.DOMAIN_ID AND E.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND E.POS_CD = C.CODE)
E.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND E.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd} AND D.DEPT_CD = (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM EMP_MASTER WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND EMAIL = #{email}) AND C.CODE_DIV = '03000' AND (E.HIDDEN_YN != 'Y' OR E.HIDDEN_YN IS NULL)
ORDER BY C.SORT_ORD LIMIT 1

SELECT em.DOMAIN_ID , em.COMPANY_CD , em.EMAIL , em.EMP_NM , em.EMP_ENG_NM , em.EMP_NO , em.POS_CD , em.DEPT_CD , em.EMP_STATUS_CD , em.ENTER_DT , em.QUIT_DT , em.HIDDEN_YN , em.JOB_TEL_NO , em.MOBILE_TEL_NO , em.MANUAL_MNG_YN , em.UPDATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(em.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , em.CREATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(em.CREATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS CREATE_DT FROM EMP_MASTER em
em.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND em.EMAIL = #{email}
